reactive-resume-reactive-resume-reactive.description: Writes or updates academic CVs for research, postdoctoral, faculty and teaching appointments. Organizes publications, funding, teaching, mentoring and service with exact authorship and status; use a role resume skill for an industry resume rather than an academic record.

Interviews the user to build a reusable bank of real achievements, scope and evidence before resume writing. Use when the user cannot remember accomplishments, has scattered performance notes or lacks metrics; use resume-bullet-writer when the task is already to rewrite specific bullets.

Drafts job-application short answers, supporting statements and selection-criteria responses from resume evidence within supplied limits. Use for form questions such as why this role or describe a relevant achievement; not for submitting applications, legal eligibility decisions or restricted assessments.

Writes a resume for a move into a new profession or industry, including military-to-civilian transitions and return-to-work pivots. Maps transferable evidence without relabeling past jobs or implying unearned expertise; use resume-tailor for matching an already-positioned resume to one posting.

Writes or edits a cover letter or application email from the user's experience and a target role. Use for a standalone letter, including a career-change or returning-to-work explanation; resume-tailor remains the workflow for tailoring the resume and optional letter together.

Writes customer success, implementation, onboarding and customer support resumes. Distinguishes adoption, renewals, expansion and support quality from sales claims, with honest portfolio and retention metrics.

Writes data analyst, analytics engineer, data engineer, data scientist and machine-learning resumes. Connects methods and data products to decisions while distinguishing offline evaluation, experiments and production results; use academic-cv for an academic research record.

Writes product design, UX/UI, user research, service design and visual design resumes. Connects research and craft to decisions and outcomes, with honest portfolio and accessibility claims; use portfolio-case-study for the longer project narrative.

Writes school teaching, educational leadership, instructional design and learning-and-development resumes. Connects curriculum, facilitation and assessment to supported outcomes while preserving credential status and learner privacy; use academic-cv for faculty scholarship records.

Writes first-job, student, internship, apprenticeship and recent-graduate resumes from education, projects, placements, volunteering and part-time work. Use when formal experience is limited; do not manufacture employment, credentials or project outcomes.

Writes director, VP, C-suite and board-candidate resumes from leadership scope, decisions and results. Distinguishes enterprise outcomes from personal ownership and operating roles from board service; use offer-negotiation for compensation rather than resume positioning.

reactive-resume-reactive-resume-agents-f.description: Fill missing Reactive Resume translations across all configured web and mobile locales using parallel subagents, then prove catalog completeness. Use for “fill translations”, “complete translations”, missing locale strings, or a request to ensure translations are complete before release. Cover existing gaps unrelated to the current task unless the user explicitly narrows scope. Do not activate for ordinary prose translation or a read-only audit that forbids edits.

reactive-resume-reactive-resume-reactive.description: Writes accounting, audit, FP&A, treasury, banking and investment resumes. Presents financial scope, analysis, controls and transactions with accurate attribution, currency and credential status; does not give investment or licensing advice.

Writes nursing, allied-health, clinical support and healthcare administration resumes. Keeps licenses, placements, clinical scope and quality outcomes accurate while protecting patient privacy; use academic-cv for scholarly or research appointment records.

Prepares the user for a specific interview from their real experience. Builds a story bank in Situation/Task/Action/Result/Reflection form mapped to the competencies the role and company test (such as Amazon's Leadership Principles), writes a cited company and role brief from public sources, predicts questions per round, drafts opener, why-us, weakness and salary answers, prepares questions to ask and a logistics checklist, and runs a post-interview debrief. Use when the user says "help me prepare for my interview", "I have an interview tomorrow" or "in 2 hours", "build my story bank", "STAR…

Runs the job-search pipeline. Adds jobs from a link or pasted posting, keeps stages and dates accurate, sets follow-ups, runs a weekly review (stale applications, next actions, funnel stats), records the exact resume version sent, and drafts networking, LinkedIn, referral, recruiter-reply, follow-up, thank-you, status-check, expedite and withdrawal messages without sending them. Use when the user says "add this job to my tracker", "I applied", "log my interview", "I got rejected", "I was ghosted", "log my offer", "track my applications", "do my weekly review", "what should I follow up on",…

Writes LinkedIn headlines, About sections and experience descriptions from verified career facts, keeping the public profile consistent with the resume. Use for profile content and positioning, not posting schedules, outreach automation or promises of recruiter ranking.

Writes growth, performance, brand, lifecycle, content and communications resumes. Connects audience and channel choices to evidenced results with clear attribution; use technical-writer-resume for product documentation rather than marketing content.

Runs a mock interview for a specific job description. Plays the interviewer in a chosen round (recruiter screen, hiring manager, behavioral, coding, system design, case, product sense, panel), persona and difficulty; asks one question at a time, probes vague answers, and gives quote-backed rubric scores after each answer (coach mode) or at the end (realistic). Model answers use only the user's real experience. Use when the user says "mock interview me", "interview me for this job", "practice interview", "pretend you're the interviewer", "grill me for this role", "run a behavioral round",…

Evaluates and negotiates job offers. Decodes base, bonus, equity, sign-on, level and terms with unknowns kept unknown and each offer in its own currency, benchmarks against checkable pay data, finds true leverage, drafts one counter as email and call script, role-plays the recruiter, and handles the salary-expectations number, deadlines and extensions, "best and final", competing offers, counteroffers and written acceptance or decline. Country-aware (India CTC, 13th-month pay, public-sector scales). Use when the user says "I got an offer of...", "is this offer good", "should I negotiate",…

Writes operations, supply-chain, logistics, manufacturing, maintenance, retail and hospitality resumes. Connects process and service work to throughput, quality, cost and safety without inventing savings, licenses or site-wide credit.

Turns a real project or resume achievement into a portfolio case study or work-sample narrative. Use for design, product, engineering, data, marketing or writing portfolios where decisions, individual contribution and evidence matter; not for invented client success stories or general blog content.

Writes product management resumes for associate, growth, platform, technical and senior product roles. Shows customer problems, prioritization, decisions and outcomes with accurate attribution; use project-manager-resume for delivery governance rather than product direction.

Writes project, program, delivery and PMO resumes using scope, dependencies, risk, schedule and outcomes. Use for delivery leadership and coordination; use product-manager-resume when the main evidence is product discovery, prioritization and customer outcomes.

Builds a complete resume as Reactive Resume JSON that conforms to the schema and imports at https://rxresu.me. Asks for missing facts, then produces valid JSON with UUIDs, HTML descriptions, template and layout. Use when the user requests importable JSON, creation in Reactive Resume, or help with its schema, sections, templates or layout. Use resume-writer for a general text draft, resume-content-guide for a content audit, resume-bullet-writer for bullets and resume-tailor for one posting.

Turns resume duties into truthful impact bullets, asking for real evidence and preserving estimates. Use for rewriting bullets, quantifying achievements or improving an experience section, including work without numeric outcomes. With Reactive Resume MCP, edits descriptions after approval. Use accomplishment-inventory for a reusable evidence bank, resume-writer for a complete text draft or summary, resume-content-guide for what belongs, resume-tailor for one posting and resume-builder for JSON.

Advises what belongs on a resume or CV, what to omit, section order, length, gaps, personal details, and country or industry conventions. Audits existing content without a specific posting. Use for questions about photos, GPA, dates of birth, summaries or career situations. Use resume-writer or a role skill for a new text draft, resume-proofreader for editorial cleanup, resume-bullet-writer for bullets, resume-tailor for one posting and resume-builder for JSON. Works from pasted text or Reactive Resume MCP.

Proofreads resume, CV and cover-letter drafts for grammar, clarity, consistency and unsupported wording while preserving facts and voice. Use for a final editorial pass or a bounded wording fix; use resume-content-guide for section selection and resume-tailor for job matching.

Tailors one resume to one specific job posting. Builds a must-have/nice-to-have requirement table, an evidence map, gap questions instead of invention, a tailored copy (headline, summary, bullet order, skills), honest ATS guidance, and an optional cover letter for that posting. Use when the user says "tailor my resume to this job", "customize my CV for this posting", "match my resume to this job description", "what keywords am I missing", "make my resume ATS-friendly for this role", "will this get past the ATS", "the job asks for X and I don't have it", or pastes a job ad with a resume. Works…

Writes or rewrites a complete resume as copy-ready text from work history, notes or an existing draft. Also writes standalone headlines and summaries. Use for a general resume draft without a specific job posting; use resume-builder for Reactive Resume JSON and resume-tailor for one posting.

Writes SDR, BDR, account executive, account management, sales engineering and sales leadership resumes. Presents quota, pipeline, deals and customer outcomes with correct periods and ownership; use customer-success-resume for post-sale adoption and retention work.

Writes software engineering resumes for frontend, backend, full-stack, mobile, platform, DevOps, SRE and security engineering roles. Emphasizes technical decisions, delivered systems and defensible impact; use data-resume for analytics or model-focused work and resume-tailor for one specific posting.

Writes technical writer, documentation engineer, API writer and knowledge-management resumes. Shows audience analysis, information design, technical accuracy and usable work samples; use marketing-resume for promotional content and portfolio-case-study for a full writing sample narrative.
